# output-moderation-hooks

> Moderate LLM output with configurable regex and term rules, categories, block, redact and flag actions, optional classifiers and streaming holdback Python package `trysac-output-moderation-hooks`, import name `output_moderation_hooks`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
